hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2; node "$root/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs" codex || exit 2
hooks.commandWindows: $hookRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 }; & node "$hookRoot/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs" codex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 }
